posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Jee Le Zaraa is finally moving forward! Farhan Akhtar is scouting locations in Rajasthan for the much-awaited road trip film starring Katrina alongside Priyanka and Alia.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit drops BTS photos from Sardaar Ji 3 with Neeru Bajwa — horror comedy releasing June 27 with teaser coming soon. "Jaggi With Beautiful Chudels!"

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser from YRF's Spy Universe is here — Alia unveils her most intense spy avatar yet with Bobby Deol preparing her for her first mission.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Jee Le Zaraa is back on track! Priyanka reunites with Alia and Katrina for Farhan Akhtar's road trip drama as location scouting begins in Rajasthan.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is juggling blockbusters — currently filming King with Deepika Padukone, while rumors swirl about a Pathaan cameo in War 2 and a Jee Le Zaraa appearance.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena weighs in on the Peddi objectification row and is in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Eetha locks a Raksha Bandhan release (August 28)! Shraddha's biopic of legendary Tamasha artiste Vithabai promises one of her most emotionally demanding roles yet.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is expecting baby #2 with Ranveer! Despite the pregnancy, she's juggling King (with SRK), Raka (with Allu Arjun), and Spirit (with Prabhas).

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 has grossed ₹1800 Cr worldwide — the second biggest Indian film ever. Up next: post-apocalyptic thriller Pralay begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya named JW Marriott's first-ever Global Brand Ambassador, and at Cannes 2026 urged young actors to 'reject manufactured trends and embrace authenticity.'

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Newlywed Rashmika and husband Vijay Deverakonda visited Tirupati Balaji temple for blessings after their stunning Udaipur wedding.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Maa Inti Bangaaram releases June 19! Samantha performs all action sequences herself — in a saree. She also revealed Sai Pallavi was the original choice for the role.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun begins shooting for his mega-budget film with director Atlee in Mumbai — playing a dual role in a ₹600 Cr parallel-universe spectacle with Deepika Padukone.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crosses ₹150 Cr India net in just 4 days and is nearing the ₹200 Cr gross milestone — though the Janhvi Kapoor objectification controversy continues.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon heads to Sri Lanka for a massive action schedule! Jr NTR's lean 'Luger' look broke records with 64M+ YouTube views in 24 hours. A second bulked-up avatar is coming.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars opposite Ram Charan in Peddi, which is dominating the box office — but her role has sparked a fierce debate about female objectification in cinema.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya has crossed ₹26 Cr India net after two weeks. Up next: Call Me Bae Season 2 on Amazon Prime Video.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: War 2 confirmed for IMAX release on August 14 — Kiara stars alongside Hrithik and Jr NTR in YRF's biggest Spy Universe film yet.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Rakesh Roshan shuts down Krrish 4 budget clash rumors — 'all is smooth.' Meanwhile, Hrithik says he'd love a dark role like Zaffar from Luck By Chance.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai hit theatres June 5 — David Dhawan's final directorial venture, a rom-com also starring Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal announces 'The Unstoppable Tour' across the US this September — Boston, Vienna (VA), Newark and more cities on the lineup.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's score for Ram Charan's Peddi is winning hearts as the film races past ₹150 Cr — the Oscar-winning composer continues to dominate Indian cinema's biggest releases.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay launches 'Singapen Special Force' for women's safety with ₹354 Cr allocation — fulfilling a key election promise after his historic political rise.
